sonuclar.baslik: ADMIN_PASSWORD bos birakilirsa compose uyari veriyor
sonuclar.detay:
Compose uyarisi bekleniyordu:
name: ipa-ota-download
services:
  app:
    build:
      context: /Users/senolpazar/Desktop/Projects/ipa-ota-download
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    environment:
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: ""
      ADMIN_PASSWORD_FORCE_RESET: "false"
      DATA_DIR: /data
      LOG_LEVEL: info
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "3000"
      PUBLIC_BASE_URL: https://x.test
      SESSION_SECRET: def
      TRUST_PRO

Compose ta sabit degerler (.env NODE_ENV/PORT/DATA_DIR) ezilemez
ACME_EMAIL bos iken Caddyfile gecerli mi
DOMAIN + ACME_EMAIL dolu iken Caddyfile gecerli
Caddy container i saglikli calisiyor mu (mevcut yigin)
